description.en: Causes, consequences and solutions of road traffic accidents, with listening, reading, grammar, speaking and writing skills.
description.am: የመንገድ ትራፊክ አደጋዎች መንስኤዎች፣ ውጤቶችና መፍትሔዎች፤ ከማዳመጥ፣ ንባብ፣ ሰዋስው፣ ንግግርና ጽሑፍ ክህሎቶች ጋር።

title.en: Speaking: Road Traffic Accidents, Agreeing and Disagreeing
title.am: ንግግር፦ የመንገድ ትራፊክ አደጋዎች፣ መስማማትና አለመስማማት

summary.en: Discuss the causes and solutions of traffic accidents in Ethiopia, complete a dialogue, and use polite expressions to agree and disagree.
summary.am: በኢትዮጵያ የትራፊክ አደጋዎችን መንስኤዎችና መፍትሔዎች መወያየት፣ ውይይትን ማሟላት፣ እና ለመስማማትና ላለመስማማት ጨዋ አገላለጾችን መጠቀም።

text.en: Road traffic accidents have become a **serious problem** in Ethiopia. Many people die or are injured every year.
text.am: የመንገድ ትራፊክ አደጋዎች በኢትዮጵያ **ከባድ ችግር** ሆነዋል። በየዓመቱ ብዙ ሰዎች ይሞታሉ ወይም ይጎዳሉ።

rows.am: poor quality of roads (ደካማ የመንገድ ጥራት)

text.en: excessive speeding, poor driving skills, drunk driving, using a phone while driving, old vehicles.
text.am: excessive speeding (ከልክ ያለፈ ፍጥነት)፣ poor driving skills (ደካማ የማሽከርከር ክህሎት)፣ drunk driving (ጠጥቶ ማሽከርከር)፣ በማሽከርከር ላይ ስልክ መጠቀም፣ ያረጁ ተሽከርካሪዎች።

text.en: Useful sentence patterns for a dialogue about traffic accidents:
text.am: ስለ ትራፊክ አደጋ ለሚደረግ ውይይት ጠቃሚ የዓረፍተ ነገር አወቃቀሮች፦

items.am: "Several people **lose their lives** every day." (በየቀኑ ብዙ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን ያጣሉ።)
"It is **because** drivers break traffic rules." (ምክንያቱም አሽከርካሪዎች የትራፊክ ሕግ ስለሚጥሱ ነው።)
"The government **must** maintain the roads." (መንግሥት መንገዶችን መጠገን አለበት።)
"Road users **should** respect traffic rules." (የመንገድ ተጠቃሚዎች የትራፊክ ሕግን ማክበር አለባቸው።)

text.en: Use **must** and **should** (expressing obligation, lesson 3.4) to give solutions.
text.am: መፍትሔ ለመስጠት **must** እና **should** (ግዴታን መግለጽ፣ ትምህርት 3.4) ተጠቀሙ።

text.en: We express **agreement** when we have the same opinion as the speaker.
text.am: ከተናጋሪው ጋር ተመሳሳይ አስተያየት ሲኖረን **መስማማትን (Agreement)** እንገልጻለን።

items.am: I agree with you 100 percent. (መቶ በመቶ እስማማለሁ)
That's so true. (በጣም እውነት ነው)
That's for sure. (እርግጠኛ ነው)
You're absolutely right. (ፍጹም ትክክል ነህ/ነሽ)
Absolutely. / Exactly. (በትክክል)
That's exactly how I feel. (እኔም ልክ እንደዚያ ይሰማኛል)
No doubt about it. (ምንም ጥርጥር የለውም)

items.en: I was just going to say that.
items.am: I was just going to say that. (እኔም ያንኑ ልናገር ነበር)

text.en: Sometimes we agree, but **not completely**. We use weaker expressions:
text.am: አንዳንድ ጊዜ እንስማማለን፣ ግን **ሙሉ በሙሉ አይደለም**። ደካማ አገላለጾችን እንጠቀማለን፦

items.en: I suppose so. / I guess so.
items.am: I suppose so. / I guess so. (እንደዚያ ይመስለኛል)
You have a point there. (እዚያ ላይ ትክክል ነህ/ነሽ)

items.en: I have to side with Dad on this one.
items.am: I have to side with Dad on this one. (በዚህ ጉዳይ ከአባቴ ጋር እቆማለሁ)

items.en: I don't have any objection to it.
items.am: I don't have any objection to it. (ምንም ተቃውሞ የለኝም)

text.en:
Mother: Television has a bad influence on children.
Father: **That's exactly my opinion.** We should limit their time for watching TV.
text.am:
እናት፦ Television has a bad influence on children.
አባት፦ **That's exactly my opinion.** (ሙሉ በሙሉ እስማማለሁ።) We should limit their time for watching TV.

text.en: We express **disagreement** when our opinion is different. Polite expressions keep the discussion friendly.
text.am: አስተያየታችን የተለየ ሲሆን **አለመስማማትን (Disagreement)** እንገልጻለን። ጨዋ አገላለጾች ውይይቱን ወዳጃዊ ያደርጉታል።

items.am: I don't think so. (እንደዚያ አይመስለኝም)
I'm afraid I disagree. (ይቅርታ፣ አልስማማም)
I beg to differ. (በአክብሮት የተለየ አስተያየት አለኝ)
Not necessarily. (የግድ አይደለም)

items.en: That's not always true / the case.
items.am: That's not always true / the case. (ሁልጊዜ እውነት አይደለም)

items.en: No, I'm not so sure about that.
items.am: No, I'm not so sure about that. (አይ፣ በዚያ ላይ እርግጠኛ አይደለሁም)

items.en: I don't think I agree with you.
items.am: I don't think I agree with you. (የምስማማህ/የምስማማሽ አይመስለኝም)
No way. (በፍጹም)
I totally disagree. (ፈጽሞ አልስማማም)
I'd say the exact opposite. (እኔ ተቃራኒውን ነው የምለው)
I can't accept it. (ልቀበለው አልችልም)
I'm afraid you're wrong. (ይቅርታ፣ ተሳስተሃል/ተሳስተሻል)

text.en:
Lea: I think 'dangdut' music is only for villagers.
Sam: **I'm afraid you're wrong.** Even high-class people enjoy it.
text.am:
ሊያ፦ I think 'dangdut' music is only for villagers.
ሳም፦ **I'm afraid you're wrong.** (አልስማማም።) Even high-class people enjoy it.

text.en: Don't be fooled by politeness: **"I'm afraid..."** and **"I beg to differ"** sound soft but they mean **disagreement**.
text.am: በጨዋነቱ አትታለሉ፦ **"I'm afraid..."** እና **"I beg to differ"** ለስላሳ ቢመስሉም **አለመስማማትን** ያመለክታሉ።

definition.en: Saying that you have the same opinion as the speaker.
definition.am: ከተናጋሪው ጋር ተመሳሳይ አስተያየት እንዳላችሁ መግለጽ።

definition.en: Saying that your opinion is different from the speaker's.
Putting more passengers or goods in a vehicle than it is allowed to carry.
definition.am: ተሽከርካሪ ከተፈቀደለት በላይ ተሳፋሪዎችን ወይም ዕቃዎችን መጫን።

definition.en: Teaching people about a problem so that they change their behaviour.
definition.am: ሰዎች ባሕርያቸውን እንዲቀይሩ ስለ አንድ ችግር ማስተማር።

definition.en: Repairing and looking after roads so they stay safe.

points.en: Causes: breaking traffic rules, overloading, poor roads.
points.am: መንስኤዎች፦ የትራፊክ ሕግ መጣስ፣ ከአቅም በላይ መጫን፣ ደካማ መንገዶች።

points.en: Solutions: respecting rules, awareness creation, road maintenance.
points.am: መፍትሔዎች፦ ሕግን ማክበር፣ ግንዛቤ መፍጠር፣ የመንገድ ጥገና።

points.en: Strong: "You're absolutely right." "That's exactly how I feel."
points.am: ጠንካራ፦ "You're absolutely right." "That's exactly how I feel."

points.en: Weak: "I suppose so." "You have a point there."
points.am: ደካማ፦ "I suppose so." "You have a point there."

points.en: Polite: "I'm afraid I disagree." "I beg to differ." "Not necessarily."
points.am: ጨዋ፦ "I'm afraid I disagree." "I beg to differ." "Not necessarily."

question.en: Activity 1: In groups of 3 or 4, discuss the major causes and solutions of traffic accidents in Ethiopia. Use the table (breaking traffic rules, overloading, poor quality of roads / respecting traffic rules, awareness creation, road maintenance) and add your own ideas.
question.am: ተግባር 1፦ በ3 ወይም በ4 ቡድን ሆናችሁ በኢትዮጵያ የትራፊክ አደጋዎችን ዋና መንስኤዎችና መፍትሔዎች ተወያዩ። ሰንጠረዡን ተጠቀሙ፣ የራሳችሁንም ሐሳብ ጨምሩ።

tip.en: Match each cause with a solution: rules ↔ respecting rules, overloading ↔ awareness, roads ↔ maintenance.
tip.am: እያንዳንዱን መንስኤ ከመፍትሔ ጋር አዛምዱ፦ ሕግ ↔ ሕግ ማክበር፣ ከአቅም በላይ መጫን ↔ ግንዛቤ፣ መንገድ ↔ ጥገና።

hints.en: Start with: "One major cause of traffic accidents is ... because ..."
hints.am: እንዲህ ጀምሩ፦ "One major cause of traffic accidents is ... because ..."

hints.en: Give a solution with must/should: "Drivers should ...", "The government must ..."
hints.am: በmust/should መፍትሔ ስጡ፦ "Drivers should ..."፣ "The government must ..."

text.en: Cause: Many drivers break traffic rules, e.g. they drive too fast.
text.am: መንስኤ፦ ብዙ አሽከርካሪዎች የትራፊክ ሕግ ይጥሳሉ፤ ለምሳሌ በጣም በፍጥነት ያሽከረክራሉ።

why.en: Speeding gives the driver no time to stop.

text.en: Cause: Minibuses and trucks are often overloaded.
text.am: መንስኤ፦ ሚኒባሶችና የጭነት መኪናዎች ብዙ ጊዜ ከአቅም በላይ ይጫናሉ።

why.en: An overloaded vehicle is hard to control.
why.am: ከአቅም በላይ የተጫነ ተሽከርካሪ ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ ነው።

text.en: Solutions: respect traffic rules, create awareness through the media and schools, and maintain the roads.
text.am: መፍትሔዎች፦ የትራፊክ ሕግን ማክበር፣ በመገናኛ ብዙኃንና በትምህርት ቤቶች ግንዛቤ መፍጠር፣ መንገዶችን መጠገን።

answer.en: Model answer: "One major cause is breaking traffic rules. Drivers should respect the rules, and the government must create awareness and maintain the roads."
answer.am: የሞዴል መልስ፦ "One major cause is breaking traffic rules. Drivers should respect the rules, and the government must create awareness and maintain the roads."

question.en:
Activity 2: Act out the dialogue and complete the missing clauses.
Tewabe: These days, traffic accidents have become a serious problem in our country, isn't it?
Regassa: Yes, it is. Several people (1) ______.
Tewabe: What do you think is the reason for that?
Regassa: Because (2) ______.
Tewabe: What must the government do to solve this problem?
Regassa: (3) ______.
Tewabe: What about the road users?
Regassa: (4) ______.
Tewabe: The roads themselves also cause traffic accidents, don't they?
Regassa: Yes, they do. (5) ______
question.am: ተግባር 2፦ ውይይቱን ተጫወቱ፤ የጎደሉትን ሐረጎች አሟሉ። (ውይይቱ በእንግሊዝኛ ነው፤ ከላይ ያሉትን የመንስኤና የመፍትሔ ሐረጎች ተጠቀሙ።)

tip.en: Use the phrases from the causes/solutions table. Answer each question with one full sentence.
tip.am: ከመንስኤ/መፍትሔ ሰንጠረዡ ሐረጎቹን ተጠቀሙ። እያንዳንዱን ጥያቄ በአንድ ሙሉ ዓረፍተ ነገር መልሱ።

hints.en: (1) is about deaths and injuries. (2) is a cause. (3)–(5) are solutions.
hints.am: (1) ስለ ሞትና ጉዳት ነው። (2) መንስኤ ነው። (3)–(5) መፍትሔዎች ናቸው።

hints.en: Use "must" for the government and "should" for road users.

text.en: (1) Several people **lose their lives or are injured every day**.
text.am: (1) Several people **lose their lives or are injured every day**.

text.en: (2) Because **many drivers break traffic rules and vehicles are overloaded**.
text.am: (2) Because **many drivers break traffic rules and vehicles are overloaded**.

text.en: (3) **The government must create awareness and punish drivers who break the rules.**
text.am: (3) **The government must create awareness and punish drivers who break the rules.**

text.en: (4) **Road users should respect traffic rules and cross at zebra crossings.**
text.am: (4) **Road users should respect traffic rules and cross at zebra crossings.**

text.en: (5) Yes, they do. **Poor-quality roads need regular maintenance.**
text.am: (5) Yes, they do. **Poor-quality roads need regular maintenance.**

answer.en: Any correct, complete sentences that use the causes and solutions are acceptable. The model answers are above.
answer.am: መንስኤዎቹንና መፍትሔዎቹን የሚጠቀሙ ማንኛውም ትክክለኛና ሙሉ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ተቀባይነት አላቸው። የሞዴል መልሶቹ ከላይ ናቸው።

question.en: Express your agreement on this topic using expressions of agreement: "Foreign aid does not necessarily solve the problems of developing countries."
question.am: በዚህ ርዕስ ላይ የመስማማት አገላለጾችን ተጠቅማችሁ መስማማታችሁን ግለጹ፦ "Foreign aid does not necessarily solve the problems of developing countries."

tip.en: Start with an agreement expression, then give a reason.
tip.am: በመስማማት አገላለጽ ጀምሩ፣ ከዚያ ምክንያት ስጡ።

hints.en: Choose one: "I agree with you 100 percent." / "That's so true." / "You're absolutely right."
hints.am: አንዱን ምረጡ፦ "I agree with you 100 percent." / "That's so true." / "You're absolutely right."

hints.en: Reason idea: countries need their own work, skills and good governance to develop.
hints.am: የምክንያት ሐሳብ፦ አገሮች ለማደግ የራሳቸው ሥራ፣ ክህሎትና መልካም አስተዳደር ያስፈልጋቸዋል።

text.en: Agreement expression: "**You're absolutely right.**"
